metadata.description: DeepCell plugins for Claude Code — build models and memos that record the reasoning, the calculations, the document and the deck together with the links between them, so when an assumption changes you can see which conclusions still hold.

plugins.name: deepcell
plugins.description: Put your ideas, calculations, documents, and slides into .deepcell files. These files remember how all the parts are connected. If you change one idea, you can quickly see how it affects the whole work. Right now, the way to open the file is by clicking the link the agent gives you. You can also turn it into Excel, Word, or PowerPoint files that you can still edit.
